modules.title: Contact payment rules view
modules.scope: Builds Layercake.vw_fact_contact_payment_source with the columns and rules in DES-001: TRANSTYPE 15 scope, test-account exclusion, sign-reversed amounts at FO precision, payment method code and name with their fallbacks, adjusted payment date with calendar year and month, contact or corporate attribution with a stable single-contact choice, and current country, region and market with 'Unknown' fallbacks. It reads synapse_fo.CUSTTRANS, synapse_fo.CUSTPAYMMODETABLE, CE.tblContact_Test_Records, Layercake.brnz_contact and Layercake.dim_country without changing them. It does not build the table, the load procedure, grants for report users or the reconciliation view.

modules.title: Contact payment table, full-rebuild load and schedule hook
modules.scope: Builds the table Layercake.fact_contact_payment (columns, primary key and audit columns per DES-001) and Layercake.usp_load_fact_contact_payment, which rebuilds the table in full from Layercake.vw_fact_contact_payment_source in one transaction, logs start and end through Layercake.usp_etl_log_start and Layercake.usp_etl_log_end, and follows the standard error handling. It adds a call to the procedure, passing @run_id, in the existing Layercake.usp_load_gold after the dimension steps (Q-024). That changes an existing object, with a down script that restores it. It also scripts the read grant on the table for the reporting role, for a human to run. It does not change the rules view or build the reconciliation view.

modules.title: Per-legal-entity reconciliation view
modules.scope: Builds Layercake.vw_contact_payment_reconciliation: one row per legal entity, with the dataset's row count and amount_paid_gbp total from Layercake.fact_contact_payment next to the FO count and -1 times the FO AMOUNTMST total. The FO side is computed directly from synapse_fo.CUSTTRANS (TRANSTYPE 15, test accounts excluded via CE.tblContact_Test_Records), and an is_reconciled flag shows whether both sides agree. It also scripts the read grant for the reporting role, for a human to run. It does not change the table, the load or the rules view.
